_comment: E7 ground-truth geometry. Frame: metres, origin at room centre, x right, y front (matches speaker_layout.json). EDIT every xy to the tape-measured value — the analysis is only as honest as this file. anchor serial null = beacon not assigned yet (tools/beacon_id.py).

room.note: anchor triangle re-taped 2026-09-08: equilateral, side 3.25 m (tape read 320-330 cm between each pair, so treat side as 3.25 +/- 0.05; that 5 cm is well under the ~0.5 m errors being measured). Replaces the 2.0/2.7/2.7 m triangle of 2026-08-25 whose shortest pair was also its weakest link.

environment.note: EDIT: lab occupancy, other 2.4GHz traffic, furniture

grid.spacing_note: 4x3 grid, 0.5 m wall margin; plus CEN/MLB/MLR/MRB placement-friendly points (triangle centre + speaker-pair midpoints) | BL/BR/BB added 2026-09-08: 0.50 m radially BEHIND each speaker (outward from the centroid). Maximum-discrimination placement — each sits ~50 cm from its own anchor and ~3.7 m from the other two, so a centroid-biased estimator cannot score well. Chosen over the edge midpoints because it is far easier to place accurately, and placement error is indistinguishable from radio error. | XLB/XRB/XLR added 2026-09-08: the ACTUAL trilaterated positions of the three 'between the speakers' orbs in run n07_two_radii. They sit OUTSIDE the anchor triangle (1.83-2.19 m from centre), not on the edge midpoints MLB/MLR/MRB (0.94 m) that were assumed at capture time. Derived from tape distances to the two nearest anchors and confirmed against the third. | NL/NR/NB added 2026-09-08: 1.00 m from the centre, on the line toward each speaker, INSIDE the triangle. Deliberately the same bearings as BL/BR/BB (2.38 m) so the pair differs only in radius — the paired design that distinguishes a constant scale from a range-dependent compression.
